$comment: Workplace window light while Reactor Bots work there (user 2026-11-02: "We have blue windows when the bots are doing stuff, we should make it neon green when nuclear bots do things."). Native (decompiled 1.1.2.8): a workplace with WorkplaceIlluminatorSpec gets WorkplaceIlluminator (lights on while Workplace.AnyWorkerHasJobRunning), WorkerTypeIlluminator (colorizer priority 20: BotColors.BotIlluminationColor, IlluminationColor.Bot, while the workplace's worker type is Bot) and Illuminator (the highest-priority colour wins). Deep Frontier adds ReactorBotWorkplaceLight (src/DeepFrontier/Scripts/SuperBots/ReactorBotWorkplaceLight.cs, colorizer priority 30, above the bot blue, below the player's own colour, CustomizableIlluminator 100): this colour while at least one Reactor Bot assigned there has its job running. Written by tools/reactor_bot_workplace_light_content.mjs as the colour blueprint and a BotColors-style singleton; checked by tools/validate_reactor_bot_workplace_light.mjs. Neon green #39FF14; not a player preset (no IlluminationPresetSpec), like the Reactor Bot eye colour.
